reconcile.note: Henry traces the divergent counts to two different sons of David, with Matthew following Solomon's royal descendants and Luke following Nathan's line through Salathiel.

discrepancy.note: Strauss counts a striking mismatch: Luke has 41 generations between David and Jesus, Matthew only 26.

quotes.text: More important is the considerable difference in the number of generations for equal periods, Luke having 41 between David and Jesus, whilst Matthew has only 26.
quotes.attr: David Friedrich Strauss (d. 1874), The Life of Jesus Critically Examined, trans. George Eliot (1846), ch. on the genealogies, on Matthew 1 and Luke 3.

sides.snippet: Zerubbabel became the father of Abiud. Abiud became the father of Eliakim. Eliakim became the father of Azor.
